name: FlagEval
description: We conduct a moderate-scale contamination-free (to some extent) evaluation of current large reasoning models (LRMs) with some preliminary findings. We also release ROME, our evaluation benchmark for vision language models intended to test reasoning from visual clues. We attach links to the benchmark, evaluation data, and other updates on this website: https://flageval-baai.github.io/LRM-Eval/
reputation: A recent benchmark from BAAI for evaluating large reasoning models and vision-language reasoning, but not yet a long-established community standard.
